name: Language Constellation
description: Neutral, measured map of programming languages and the computation stack. Provides language structure, coverage, emission templates, compiler landscape, and stack-collapse evidence as machine-readable data.

skills.name: Language coverage lookup
skills.description: Return measured named-node coverage, construct count, structural entropy and redundancy for a language, from real tree-sitter grammars.
examples: What is the measured coverage of Rust?

skills.name: Cross-language emission
skills.description: Return per-construct surface templates (emission LUT) for translating one meaning between languages.
examples: Show the add construct in Rust and Python.

skills.name: Compiler landscape and fault lines
skills.description: Return compiler lineage, landscape families, fault lines, and the unsiloed target layers.
examples: What fault lines cause compiler fragmentation?

skills.name: Derive-from-ISA evidence
skills.description: Return measured derive-vs-clang instruction counts and proof verdicts for the RISC-V prototype.
examples: How many instructions does derived popcount use vs clang baseline?
